notes.title: Feedback and Reviews Updates
notes.content:
After reading the feedback in the reviews and watching the YouTube uploads I updated the following:

Improved turning 
[list]
[*]     Easier to steer vehicle and not get stuck on walls when wheels are slipping[/list]

Updated Default Keyboard inputs:
[list]
[*]      "W" now accelerate (Previously "Left Click")
[*]      "Q" rolls vehicle counter-clockwise in air (Previously "C")
[*]      "E" rolls vehicle clockwise in air (Previously "V")
[*]      "F" Toggles camera from auto mode and free mode (Previously "E")
[*]      "Left click" boosts (Previously "Right Click")[/list]

Simplified first level tutorial with more input explanations and reduced text

Added new checkpoint in level 4 to reduce frustrations

Side note - Inputs may still be customized in the settings within the main menu

notes.title: Adding Respawn Button
notes.content: Added a respawn button in the pause menu to make respawning easier to notice. By default it is "Backspace" on keyboard and "face button right" on controller.

notes.title: Timer Doubling fix
notes.content: In the midst of my prior update rage I ended up fixing the crash but then braking the visual on the timer. This update now properly destroys and creates the timer UI visual.

notes.title: Crash fix update
notes.content: Noticed that a crash was occurring on replay. Was annoying me when I was trying to grind the first level since someone beat my time so I fixed it.
